title: Had Charlie Johnson already played Small's Paradise?
summary: Pressed by Schaap, Waters admits Elmer Snowden's band may have been at Small's before Johnson's and he cannot say the band had played New York before he joined.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: The band already had played in New York before you were in his band.
Yeah.
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
They had played Small's -
I think so, now I think that -
You just said -
I know - wait a minute, I need check on that again. They had another guitar player, guitar, banjo player that used to work with Duke Ellington, Elmer Snowden -
Elmer Snowden -
Elmer Snowden, it's possible that Elmer Snowden played there a period before and me took his place, somethin' like that.
See, what I -
It's possible -

I'm tryin' to, you just went into a big statement saying that the Paradise, Atlantic City and Small's Paradise are the responsible for the name Charlie Johnson's Band. But if they hadn't played Small's Paradise yet when you joined in the Atlantic City Paradise, then the Paradise they got their name from is the Atlantic City one.
Well, that could have been also because I mean - anyway the both places were named Paradise, you know. Paradise in New York and Paradise in Atlantic City, both were named Paradise.
Right, but -
But -
You joined the band knowing -
If he didn't get it from Atlantic City of New York, he got it from Atlantic City, I mean.
Yeah.
That is, that's just a little technical thing there.
But you joined the band - well, that's what it all is (laughs) - you joined the band in Atlantic City in the knowledge that you would be going to New York.
Yeah, because that's where we're going, I mean -
Right. But you don't know for certain that they had been to New York before, you just knew they were going to New York.
Benny Waters JDHP 6/6/82
No, I didn't know that because I just, I'm the last one to join the band, see. I didn't know exactly that, see. I knew they were going to New York because the guy told me that they -
I know, I know, that's what I just said -
I knew they're going to New York when I joined the band because the guy who introduced me to Charlie told me that they were get -
Right -
to go to New York, you see what I mean?
Right. So you can't say specifically either way that the Paradise in New York is responsible for the name?
No -
Matter of fact, unless they played in New York -
Yeah -
before you joined the band they would have to be the Atlantic City Paradise -
That I don't think, that I don't even remember exactly - I believe, I really believe that Elmer Snowden's band was there before, or if it wasn't Elmer Snowden it was another guy -
Uh huh -
that I had right on my tip of my tongue that played piano.
played piano, was, stayed there. And then Charlie got this job through Ed Smalls or somethin' like that.
Luis Russell?
No, no, no, no. Way before that -
Piano player?
Yeah, way before that.
